Keys                                                                                                                                           esc or ? to close
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  navigation                                           account                                              session
  j/↓          next row                                enter   switch to selected account                   s         subshell with every active slot
  k/↑          previous row                            d/i     details                                      S         subshell with only this account
  g/home       first row                               l       login                                        r         run provider CLI command
  G/end        last row                                L       login every stale account                    R         reload
  ctrl+f/pgdn  page down                               c       create account                               p         toggle detail pane
  ctrl+b/pgup  page up                                 e       edit account                                 ?         help
  tab          next provider tab                       ctrl+d  delete account                               q/ctrl+c  quit
  shift+tab    previous provider tab                   a       save current ADC to selected account
  1-9          jump to tab (1 is All)                  y       copy the env eval line
  /            filter
  esc          clear applied filter
  !            only rows needing action
  o            cycle sort: name, status, expiry
  z            fold or unfold the provider group
  :            command palette
